posts.title: Canarat rebuild / repair finished
posts.description: The Canarat pedal rebuild / repair is finally done. A few months ago actually, but I just today got around to updating the page . It sounds fantastic and I'm pretty happy with the paint job. Also, it bears a sharkweasel sticker . What could Sharkweasel be? Stay tuned.

posts.title: The Canarat lives!
posts.description: Just a quick note to say that the Canarat makes sound again! Very happy about this. A quick video proof! Now all I have to do is redo the useless tone circuit (which is not what I built, strange as that seems ). ... and take it out of the case again …

posts.title: Cursor and the danger of overpromising
